evidence_limits: Current Rust source hashes do not establish build correspondence with the accepted binary or a future successor.
No complete ancestry, consumed-seed-union or live registration audit performed.
No successor implementation, CPU/native test execution, calibration, training, evaluation or runtime qualification.
Mastery threshold, mix and exposure numbers are proposals, not user-approved requirements.
Sixty updates is a bounded early-stage pilot; later stages may remain untested.
B/E remain unopened; D100 opened and D200 consumed are preserved constraints, not freshly exercised cohorts.

findings.consequence: Equal 60-update, 256-decision rollouts do not guarantee equal Adam steps. Enforcing the stated equality would require an unregistered PPO change, topping up, or stopping one arm.
findings.resolution: Keep the inherited KL rule; define equality as rollout transitions and identical PPO settings/maximum optimization budget, and report actual epochs/Adam steps. If exact Adam-step equality is essential, specify and review a separate matched protocol before implementation.
findings.title: Equal optimizer steps conflict with unchanged PPO KL stopping
findings.trigger: The two arms cross target_kl=0.03 after different epochs.

findings.consequence: Completion order, entry reset, and exposure-clock choices change promotions and the training distribution despite identical seeds.
findings.resolution: Specify stable (learner update, rollout decision, slot) ordering, atomic completion-batch processing, one promotion boundary, stage-generation eligibility, and reset of episode/window/streak/update counters on entry. Freeze in-flight assignments. Define whether pre-minimum windows qualify, whether later failures erase eligibility, and exactly when the tenth completed stage update counts; no double-charging an update to stages.
findings.title: Stage/window state machine has multiple valid interpretations
findings.trigger: Simultaneous completions straddle a 100-episode window or promotion; old-horizon episodes remain active; two passing windows arrive before update ten.

findings.consequence: Each interpretation changes experienced frames and mastery arrival. Normal-start H episodes also practice every earlier section; 70% current episodes is neither 70% current-section frames nor guaranteed exposure beyond H-1000.
findings.resolution: Choose one explicit assignment algorithm, balancing scope, rounding/remainder order, RNG/hash, and stage-entry behavior. Use scheduler randomness independent of policy/minibatch RNG. Declare this a cumulative-prefix curriculum, not isolated section starts; log actual raw frames, reaches, and survival through each 1000-frame interval. Retain the proposed 90%, 200 episodes, 10 updates and 70/30 only as unapproved design choices, not user requirements.
findings.title: 70/30 assignment does not yet define section exposure
findings.trigger: Implementations interpret 'episode slots' as fixed vector occupancy, reset-event quotas, or Bernoulli episode draws; earlier horizons need rounding.

findings.consequence: The cohort becomes selection data; a curriculum can improve capped training mastery while regressing complete runs. The requested death-cause comparison is absent from the required metric list.
findings.resolution: Predeclare endpoint/cadence and per-replica plus paired aggregation; minimal pilot uses every terminal update-60 replica without best-of-stage/replica selection. Compare both arms and checkpoint324 on the same new normal-start cohort with cutoffs disabled, fixed action selection/backend, milestone rates, Worst/Q1/Mean/Q4/Best and death causes/caps/unknown/unavailable counts. Define survival as alive_frames (fatal frame excluded), quartile size/rounding and milestone ties. Any later candidate selection needs separate fresh confirmation and a parent-defined regression/acceptance rule; do not invent a mastery threshold.
findings.title: Full-run regression, endpoint selection, and required death metrics are unspecified
findings.trigger: Choosing a checkpoint or replica after inspecting the fresh cohort, pooling away a lower-tail regression, or implementing only the listed metrics.

findings.consequence: Even perfect success can master at most six stages and enter 7000 at the end, with no remaining training. Exposing 18000 requires at least 170 prior-stage updates; mastering all stages requires at least 180, before episode-count constraints.
findings.resolution: Explicitly label 60 updates per replica a bounded early-stage pilot; clarify global budget versus per-stage timeout, and record stages reached/mastered and untested stages. This is a limit, not permission to increase the cap.
findings.title: The 60-update pilot cannot cover the entire 18-stage program
findings.trigger: At least ten non-overlapping learner updates are required per mastered stage.

findings.consequence: Pairs may have unequal completed decisions or silently different total cost. The unspecified evaluation count/cadence prevents a complete resource bound.
findings.resolution: Pin batch size, six-run execution/concurrency plan, evaluation count/cadence, and train/eval/aggregate wall, raw-frame, memory and cleanup budgets. Count every startup (13 frames/reset), reset, initial construction, discarded work and evaluation. Define fail-closed partial-pair reporting without top-ups. At inherited batch64, each replica plans 983040 transitions and at most 7680 Adam steps; six replicas plan 5898240 transitions. Actual steps may be lower under KL stopping.
findings.title: Training equality and total resource ceilings need separate semantics
findings.trigger: One arm hits a raw-frame/wall cap first, or evaluation/baseline/checkpoint overhead is charged inconsistently.

findings.consequence: Disjointness from B/E/D128/D100/D200 alone does not prove held-out freshness or independent replicas. Matching run_seed does not mean both arms consume identical episode counts, because cutoffs reset sooner.
findings.resolution: Make the ancestry audit cover all observed/consumed seed sets, including discarded branches, and reserve the new cohort against future training in both arms before construction. Preserve B/E unopened, D100 opened and D200 consumed. Pin model/Adam restoration and replica-specific paired policy/minibatch RNG forks, run_seed/slot/episode offsets and collision handling. Treat pairing as matched streams and report actual consumed seeds/exposure; exact seed manifests may remain parent-owned registration work.
findings.title: Five named exclusions are not a complete freshness or replica contract
findings.trigger: A 'fresh' evaluation seed appeared in historical training, discarded later updates, probes/benchmarks or other consumed cohorts; replicas share restored RNG without a declared fork.

parent_anchor_verification.verification_scope: Raw byte hashes and receipt JSON fields only; no checkpoint deserialization or requalification.
